caption:
Global Metadata: A relaxed, warm Brazilian bossa nova, 92 BPM, smooth and intimate. Centered on a nylon-string classical guitar playing the signature bossa groove, joined by a soft upright bass, light shaker and a whisper of cymbals. A gentle male voice sings a mellow Portuguese verse over the guitar, the chorus lifts softly with a second harmony voice, and a guitar passage lets the smooth chords shine. Production profile: warm, close, intimate bossa nova recording, soft nylon-guitar tone, gentle and unhurried, studio mastering with generous dynamic range.

Vocal Details: One lead voice, a warm, soft male singer in Portuguese, intimate and breathy, no auto-tune, clear and unforced. In the chorus a soft second harmony voice joins, but the lead stays on top. No falsetto, no spoken dialogue.

Arrangement: Intro, the nylon-string guitar plays the smooth bossa groove with soft bass. Verse one, the warm male voice enters over the guitar, gentle and intimate. Chorus, the voice lifts softly with a second harmony, the shaker adds a light pulse. Verse two, back to the intimate verse. Guitar passage, the guitar alone plays smooth chords. Outro, a soft warm fade on guitar and voice.
lyrics:
[Intro]
Nylon-string guitar plays the smooth bossa groove, soft bass

[Verse 1]
Deixa a noite devagar
o mar me chama pra dançar
uma brisa, um olhar
e o tempo para de passar

[Chorus]
Vem, que a vida é doce aqui
a luz da lua cai em mim
vem, que a bossa vai te levar
o meu coração a cantar

[Verse 2]
Caminho à beira do mar
cada onda um novo lugar

[Guitar passage]
Guitar alone plays smooth bossa chords, no voice

[Outro]
Guitar and voice, soft warm fade
